title: Théorie de Kumer ? + note Alexandre (bi tenseur…) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Minor convention issue: with the relation ρ0ρ1ρ∞ = 1, the homomorphism ρ0 ↦ ρ0^{-1}, ρ∞ ↦ ρ∞^{-1} forces ρ1 ↦ ρ0ρ∞. The page writes ρ∞ρ0, which is conjugate to ρ0ρ∞ (by ρ0). This is fine up to an inner automorphism, base-path choice, or composition order, but it is not literally consistent under the stated relation.
Statements are only for discrete π (Ens(π) = all π-sets). The profinite or Galois-category version needs continuity and finiteness conditions, which are not stated here.
Identifying Ens(π) with the target C, in the remark '(≃ Ens(π'))', makes sense only for the special case worked out on the next page.

deep.surprise_reason: Everything on the page is standard: the Schreier formula, the complex-conjugation action on the three-point fundamental group, and the free-cocompletion/torsor description of functors between classifying topoi. It is preparatory material for a Galois/Kummer formalism for dessins, with no new result or unrecognized connection visible.
transcription_corrections: 'X π-objets [?] {+i.e. dans [?]+} C' should read approximately 'X π-objet (à droite) dans C', with 'à droite' added above.
The arrow labels read 'F commutant' above and 'aux lim' below (not 'avec lim'), i.e. 'commutant aux limites (inductives)'. The note to the right of C is also 'aux lim'.
The wavy symbols under ρ0 and ρ∞ are vertical maps-to arrows (ρ0 ↦ ρ0^{-1}, ρ∞ ↦ ρ∞^{-1}, ρ1 ↦ ρ∞ρ0), not isomorphism signs.
In the Hom formula the crossed-out 'E' is a deletion; the intended formula is Hom_C(X×_πE, Y) ≅ Hom_π(E, Hom(X,Y)) with Y ∈ Ob C.
The source category written 'Ens(π)' at left is the category of π-sets. π_s denotes π acting on itself (the regular π-set).
